commitments.detail: Rina is excluded from the panel due to her close personal relationship with Jonah and informal coaching history, which constitutes a conflict of interest. The panel will consist of Elliot, Sofia, and Tariq.
Elliot's four firsthand observations of Mara coaching team members through difficult disagreements will be entered into the formal leadership-evidence record before panel evaluations begin.

Mara will receive the interview questions at least 48 hours in advance and may submit written responses instead of answering verbally, per her documented accessibility need raised through the employee representative.
The selection packet will be updated to require a standardized question set for both candidates and individual written score sheets from every panelist, per internal-selection procedure.

Despite differing interview formats, both Mara and Jonah will have equivalent opportunity to demonstrate the leadership criteria. Panelists will evaluate both candidates against the same leadership criteria.
